images.prompt: Original landscape 3:2 fashion editorial illustration for a Tokyo handcraft journal. Fictional Japanese adult woman, 26, swept-back dark hair in a low tie, soft wide smile, slate blue knit pullover. Her right hand is lightly held up beside her collarbone, all fingers natural and in frame. On only one finger, one simple rhodium-silver-colored ring with a SMALL clear round flat-cut glass disc of approximately 15 mm, with a faint, somewhat abstract frosted radial pattern seen below a plain polished clear top, like rays through a window. Clear colourless glass, no jewel facets or raised stone. The full head, hands and jewelry are well within the composition, shot from the chest up with detail on the hand and face. Beige pale indoor background, diffuse warm daylight, photorealistic human proportions and skin, no conspicuous moles. A wholly new generic design for editorial illustration, not a copy of a designer object or a depiction of an actual item. No input images, brand, words, logo, watermark or other jewelry.

model.style: Dark hair tied back, a blue knit and a full view of the hand and face.

visualReview.notes: Clear round glass and a thin band visible in both images. The matte radial marks are illustrative.
